messages:
lee (oncall): paging — alerts for elevated 502/504 and connection resets for API frontend in apac1c, and small correlated increase in euc2. 5xx rate up ~15% for last 7m. Seeing customer reports for timeouts and websocket disconnects. incident-bot: ALERT CREATED: INC-2483459999 apac1c/euc2 ingress 5xx surge. Severity P1. lee (oncall) is paged. deploy-bot: no recent deploys to apac1c/euc2 in last 30m. ana (infra): checking LB and targetgroups. Quick datapoint: apac1c NLB shows many targets entering unhealthy state; ALB in front returns 502 with upstream reset. Target health checks failing with "connection refused" and occasionally "RST". Ravi, any ingress logs? ravi (sre): pulling envoy/ingress logs — lots of "upstream reset before response completed" and "upstream connect error: connection reset" traces. Also seeing kube-proxy conntrack eviction logs on nodes around same timeframe. Sample:
```
[envoy] 2026-03-15T11:02:14Z upstream connect error: connection reset by peer, host=10.2.5.12:8080
[kube-proxy] nf_conntrack: delete_conntrack: id 0xabc timed out
```
mika (network): Route53 weighted shift was executed at ~11:00 UTC as part of a scheduled traffic test — weights moved 70/30 apac1c->euc2. TTLs are 30s.
lee (oncall): that matches the timing. Hypothesis: rapid DNS weight change produced sudden cross-region traffic + node conntrack exhaustion -> half-open sockets -> Envoy resets -> healthcheck flaps. Immediate mitigations: 1) revert weight change, 2) set NLB deregistration_delay to high value and extend healthcheck timeout, 3) adjust ALB idle timeout / envoy keepalive to match NLB behavior, 4) roll ingress pods to clear conntrack state on nodes. Agree? ravi (sre): agree. I'll restart ingress pods one-per-node to avoid churn. ana (infra): reverting Route53 weights now.
ana (infra): revert done — propagation started (TTL 30s). Also bumping NLB targetgroup healthcheck timeout to 20s and deregistration delay to 300s. Making change.
ana (infra): NLB changes applied. Monitoring targetgroup status.
mika (network): also noticed a stale BGP advertisement from an old transit peer causing some prefixes to hairpin via euc2. I've disabled that advertisement to reduce cross-region churn.
devon (support): customers reporting intermittent improvement after the revert. Posting temporary status update to affected tenants. Affected list ~9 customers across APAC region. Notifying enterprise contacts.
ravi (sre): completed rolling restart of ingress-controller DaemonSet (one pod per node, 30s stagger). Observing reduced upstream resets on restarted nodes.
ana (infra): targetgroup healthy percentage increasing from 64% to 92% as pods recover. ALB 5xx rate trending down.
lee (oncall): keeping P1 while we watch for 20m. Action items to follow: conntrack tuning for apac nodepool, harmonize ALB/NLB/Envoy timeouts, update DNS weight-change playbook to include phased canary + synthetic probing, and remove transit BGP stale route audit. Assigning owners in RCA ticket RCA-2483459999.
incident-bot: UPDATE: Route53 revert applied, NLB timeouts increased, ingress DS roll underway, stale BGP advertisement removed.
mika (network): follow-up note — recommend setting net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max higher and tcp_established timeout to 86400 on apac nodepool. I'll draft a change and schedule with ana.
ana (infra): created infra change CHG-2483459999 to tune conntrack and a runbook link: runbooks/ingress-conntrack-tuning. Not scheduling immediate apply to avoid rolling pressure; target during maintenance window unless we see recurrence.
ravi (sre): enabling conservative Envoy retry policy and increasing upstream per-try timeout to 4s to smooth short-lived failures.
devon (support): tickets updated. Customers confirming reduced errors; labeling incident "partial degradation" while monitoring.
lee (oncall): handoff: I'll monitor another 25m then hand to ravi for the overnight watch. ravi (sre): taking handoff. I'll keep tracking metrics and coordinate with ana + mika if needed. incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED for INC-2483459999 — status: mitigated, monitoring. Please update RCA ticket with timeline and actions. :white_check_mark:
mika (network): short RCA summary: root cause was combined effect of a rapid Route53 weighted traffic shift during a scheduled test, stale transit BGP advertisement causing partial hairpin, and low conntrack capacity/timeouts on nodes leading to TCP resets and targetgroup health flaps. Mitigations: revert weights, increase LB timeouts, restart ingress pods, remove stale route, plan conntrack tuning. lee (oncall): closing thread after handoff. Thanks everyone.
